到点后自动签到勾选提供商的可用账号（WorkBuddy 国内版走每日签到接口，国: At the scheduled time, auto check-in runs for the available accounts of the selected providers (WorkBuddy China uses the daily check-in API; International uses daily activity tasks — detect the campaign, claim the daily-activity reward, then keep the account alive with free models; Raccoon uses the desktop daily points flow; AutoClaw uses the official client's daily check-in task; Qoder China uses campaign claims, and accounts with no campaign assigned get a neutral notice; Qoder International needs a device risk-control identity first (generated by the UMID component of the local Qoder client / qodercli) to see the "Daily 100 Credits" campaign, and a missing component yields a clear explanation instead of an error; Trae claims SOLO's daily check-in points (reset at midnight by calendar day), and when the upstream has no campaign for the account or the credential has no device ID the result is "not claimed + the specific reason" instead of an error; Loomy awards first-login points once a day per account; KukuAI claims the "Free points" daily tasks; OfficeAce claims all of that day's rewards in one action (daily check-in + newcomer gift)).
